A total disappointment!
Jun 2025 • Friends
I was here last year 2024 the food was amazing!!! It was worth every bite. 

Sadly 2025 it's a complete disappointment. It's definitely not worth the price!!! Each bite made me wonder "why?" I mean you could do it that way but why? 

The service was excellent!!! The hostess and the server were lovely, gentle, and very conscientious. But service alone did not save the meal. 

Please try again Tre. We want you back.

Fabulous Night out
Feb 2023 • Friends
We had a fantastic night at Tre Dining in Thao Dien, District 2. With the top of the view, we really loved and enjoyed the beautiful and dazzling view to Landmark 81. The atmosphere there was very great. High food quality, professional staffs who are always attentive to the details. Opened Kitchen with talented Chefs. The dishes were decorated nicely, well presented. You will have a staff to be ready at your service at the table and present for each dishes. Bar prices cheap, snack food prices cheap. Great night out for not a lot of money. Well worth a visit. Would definetly go back here again.
